name: burrow-go-nav
description: Qualified-symbol navigation for Burrow (architecture task 16): a Search-Everywhere QuickPick that parses `pkg.Symbol` / `pkg.Type.Method` / bare `Symbol` / lone `pkg` queries, resolves them through gopls (`vscode.executeWorkspaceSymbolProvider`) plus a `go list -json` package index, and jumps to the definition — the qualifier VS Code's ⌘T can't express.

scripts.test: node test/query.test.js && node test/packageindex.test.js && node test/seed.test.js

burrow.nav.goBinary.description: Path to the `go` binary used to build the package index (`go list -json`). Defaults to `go` on PATH.

enumDescriptions: Index only the workspace module (`go list -json ./...`) — fast, covers your own packages.
Index the workspace module plus dependencies and stdlib (`go list -json ./... all`) — slower to warm, resolves stdlib and vendored packages as jump targets.
burrow.nav.packageScope.description: How wide to build the `go list` package index used to map symbols to packages and to resolve lone-package targets.
